## Why

The reviewer reported this as tool feedback (friction) on ork in ork run ork-20261118-134755-11b1, project ork, item S419:

When a slice lists its duplicates in Why, have ork flag any other open item with a near-identical title (here S438) so the orchestrator retires it at landing

Evidence: S419 Why names S421 and S435 as duplicates; S438 is still open in the Direction list with the same title wording

This slice takes over S320's de-duplication part (note of 2026-11-18). Tool feedback filed near-identical slices again and again on 2026-11-17/18, and each was retired by hand: S416, S422, S426, S429, S433, S441 (UI pass renders); S418, S428, S436 (reviewer in plan mode); S419, S421, S435, S438 (prints-nothing Check lines).

Code evidence (2026-11-18):

- ork detects a repeat only by an exact key: `tool-feedback-SLUG-HASH`, the hash of tool, kind and the normalized proposal text (`internal/engine/toolfeedback.go:40-50`), as adj 414 (`feedback.dedupe`, stable-key) decided. A reworded proposal gets a new key and `slicer add` files a new slice (`internal/engine/toolfeedback.go:224-262`). slicer refuses only an exact duplicate title (`slicer add`).
- No slicer command finds near-duplicate titles (`slicer find near-duplicate` and `slicer find "similar title"` in slicer: no matches, 2026-11-18).
- Measured on the 13 titles above against the 25 open ork items (2026-11-18): word-set Jaccard of lower-case content words is at least 0.5 for 4 of the 24 same-family pairs (S419-S438 0.60, S435-S438 0.56, S426-S429 0.71, S418-S436 0.50) and at most 0.24 for any pair across families. A threshold of 0.5 flags the near-identical pairs with no false match in this sample, and misses the reworded ones (for example S416-S422 0.05). Wording alone cannot find every duplicate.
- The engine already holds what it needs: `slicercli.Client.List` (`internal/slicercli/slicercli.go:54`) and `Note` (`internal/slicercli/write.go:210`).

Open owner question: where ork looks for near duplicates and what it does with a match, per the owner's answer to `feedback.near-duplicates`. adj 414 stays: the exact key still skips a repeat.

## Implement

1. Write the failing tests and see each red for the stated reason.
2. Add `NearDuplicateTitles(title, selfID string, open []slicercli.Item, min float64) []string` in `internal/engine/neardup.go`: lower-case, split on every rune outside [a-z0-9], drop one-letter words and a short fixed stop-word list, compute the Jaccard index of the two word sets, and return the ids at or above `min` in list order. `min` is a constant, 0.5 (the measurement in Why).
3. `buildCard`: list the project's open items once; for the landing slice and for each slice this run's tool feedback filed, add one line `possible duplicate: ID ~ MATCH[, MATCH]`. Do not change how tool feedback files.
4. A list failure is advisory: the card shows no near-duplicate lines and the landing goes on (adj 413).
5. Docs: `docs/design.md` approval card and tool feedback filing (the near-duplicate lines, the threshold, adj 492 next to adj 414). Changelog entry with `slicer changelog add S442 --text "..."`.
